about: LEONIDA_* switches the executable selects by its Direct3D adapter; this catalog is embedded at build time.
Every profile whose match fits the PC's card is applied, in this order; a later one overrides an earlier one.
match: vendor (nvidia, amd, intel, other), min_vram_mb, max_vram_mb, name (a wildcard on the card's name); empty matches every card.
opt_in: true: never applied by its match, only when [graphics].profiles or LEONIDA_PROFILE names it.
A value of null cancels an earlier profile value. Explicit environment values override TOML graphics settings, which override profiles.
Add a profile only with a measurement: the card, the CPU, the scene and the frame times before and after.
Your own changes go in gpu-profiles.local.json beside the selected config (current folder without one); same form, applied after this catalog; git ignores it.

LEONIDA_PROFILE=<name>[,<name>...] overrides [graphics].profiles: base and those profiles whatever the card; none disables profiles while keeping explicit settings. The existing value 1 is reserved for the diagnostics CPU sampler.

profiles.name: base
profiles.measured: victory-gta6 on an RTX 4070 (docs/fork-notes.md); kept on an RTX 3080 12 GB with a Ryzen 7 7800X3D, 2026-11-26

profiles.name: nvidia-8gb
profiles.measured: RTX 3060 Ti 8 GB, Ryzen 5 5600, 16 GB, driver 621.40, Windows 11 26H2, after the shader warm-up, 2026-11-27: LEONIDA_TEXTURE_STAGE_MB=512 and LEONIDA_ASYNC_PRESENT=1 together. First gameplay room 130 ms and courtyard 129 ms usual frame with both, against 312-489 ms with stock defaults and 175-183 ms for the room with the same 512 MB staging but no asynchronous present (a separate staging sweep measured 312 -> 288 ms for staging alone); the courtyard kept 4,000-4,850 draws through the readings. See docs/notes/2026-11-27-nvidia-8gb-pair.md. RTX 4060 Ti 8 GB, Core i5-14400F, 32 GB, driver 621.40, Windows 11 26H2, after the shader warm-up, boat mission, one hand-played pair (tester amineourabi0), 2026-11-27: median frame 148 -> 157 ms, longest 1,087 -> 545 ms, no gain; see docs/notes/2026-11-27-rtx4060ti-8gb-switch-tests.md. Opt-in: it has helped on one of the two 8 GB cards measured.

profiles.name: nvidia-code-tables
profiles.measured: RTX 5090, i9-14900KS, NVIDIA 580.173.02, Pop!_OS, Proton 11.0 and vkd3d-proton 3.2.0, 2026-11-26: six refused compute pipelines went from 0/6 to 6/6 created in a compile-only comparison. No frame-rate improvement is claimed. See docs/fork-notes.md, large code-literal tables on NVIDIA.

profiles.name: readback-order
profiles.measured: RTX 5090, i9-14900KS, NVIDIA 580.173.02, Pop!_OS, Proton 11.0 and vkd3d-proton 3.2, 2026-11-27: shader-free one-texel copy and host-read regressions observed stale 0 before and correct 37 after in relay modes 0, 1 and 2. Gameplay frame-time cost is unmeasured; off by default pending a paired game run. See docs/fork-notes.md, texture readback ordering.

profiles.name: card-windows
profiles.measured: RTX 3080 12 GB, Ryzen 7 7800X3D, first rooms, 2026-11-26: usual frame 169-173 -> 149-158 ms, card time 103 -> 88 ms; but the windows take about 3.7 GB of the card and textures picked by index wait for room (host copies of textures 12,142 -> about 6,500): textures stay black. Opt-in until that is solved.

profiles.name: texture-keep
profiles.measured: RTX 3080 12 GB, Ryzen 7 7800X3D, driver 621.24, first rooms, two pairs of unattended runs, 2026-11-26: usual frame 156.5 -> 142 and 145 -> 130.5 ms; host copies of textures made again 14,986 -> 8,545 and 17,149 -> 5,674; but passes that made none for lack of room 96 -> 319 and 12 -> 390. RTX 4070 Ti SUPER 16 GB, Ryzen 9 7900X, driver 621.40, e2f881f, first rooms, two pairs (tester ondra), 2026-11-27: median frame 223.0 -> 227.0 and 260.8 -> 268.0 ms, no gain. Opt-in: it has helped only on the 12 GB card so far.

profiles.name: nvidia-swap
profiles.measured: RTX 3080 12 GB, driver 621.24, Ryzen 7 7800X3D, Series X, unattended measure-run.ps1, 2026-11-28: with base, 12.5 fps in play and 12.3 fps in the opening cutscene, against 9.2 and 3.4 fps for base alone on main; no device loss or crash report. Only this card was measured. See docs/notes/2026-11-28-nvidia-base.md. Local test of the gpu, shader, hle and formats crates of trustno1-coder/VIctory-NVIDIA 63b902f (renderer from codec-d/cool_fox f4b48ad). These are the switches the SETTINGS table of their play.rs at 63b902f turns on, renamed to LEONIDA_ (SLOT_EVICT, ALLOCATOR_TRIM and BUDGET_PACK are the memory stack by skornuta); path settings, LOG, DLSS, FRAMEGEN, FSR, MENU, FRAME_INTERVAL_US and PIPELINE_BOOK are left out. LEAVE_OUT skips two shaders (decal heap defragmentation, heat haze), so it changes the picture.

profiles.name: dlss
profiles.measured: Not measured on the swap: no frame times taken with upstream's Streamline yet. Opt-in for testers with an NVIDIA RTX card and the files from scripts/get-nvidia-dlss.ps1; without those files it changes nothing. See docs/notes/2026-11-27-dlss-super-resolution.md.

profiles.name: dlss-framegen
profiles.measured: RTX 3080 12 GB, driver 621.24, with base and nvidia-swap, 2026-11-28: FSR 3 frame generation (DLSS Frame Generation does not run on RTX 30), 11.9 fps rendered and about 24 shown (worked out from 2x, not counted), stable for 450 s. DLSS Frame Generation on RTX 40 and 50 not run yet. See docs/notes/2026-11-28-nvidia-base.md. DLSS upscaling with frame generation: DLSS Frame Generation on an RTX 40 or 50 card, AMD FSR 3 frame generation (2x at most) on others, as VIctory-NVIDIA chooses. LEONIDA_TEXTURE_ROOM_PERCENT=80 is VIctory-NVIDIA's launcher value with frame generation on (it takes 1.5 to 2 GB of the card there), not measured here. Needs the base profile's LEONIDA_ASYNC_SUBMIT=1 (or LEONIDA_THIN=1), the files from scripts/get-nvidia-dlss.ps1 and, for FSR 3, the ones from scripts/get-amd-fsr.ps1 (leonida run offers both once, default no). See docs/notes/2026-11-27-frame-generation.md.
